profile.positioning: A results-oriented cybersecurity leader specializing in the protection of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning applications within the healthcare ecosystem. I bring a unique blend of technical expertise, clinical understanding, and regulatory awareness to the challenges of securing sensitive patient data and ensuring the integrity of AI-driven clinical decision support systems. My experience spans vulnerability assessment, threat modeling, incident response, and the development of comprehensive security architectures tailored to the specific risks posed by AI/ML models. Currently, as Security Lead at St. Luke’s Regional Health Network, I am responsible for overseeing the security posture of our expanding portfolio of AI-powered diagnostic tools and personalized treatment algorithms. This includes leading a team of security engineers in conducting penetration testing, implementing security controls, and ensuring compliance with HIPAA, GDPR, and emerging AI-specific regulations. Prior to this role, my background as a Clinical Data Analyst provided me with invaluable insight into the data flows and clinical workflows that underpin modern healthcare, allowing me to anticipate vulnerabilities and develop security solutions that are both effective and practical. I am passionate about proactive security – 'security by design' – and am seeking a leadership opportunity where I can leverage my expertise to build and implement robust security strategies for organizations at the forefront of healthcare innovation. I believe that secure AI is not just a technical imperative, but a fundamental ethical responsibility in the delivery of quality patient care.
